services.name: Scuba Diving
services.desc: Wall diving, pinnacles, canyons, seals, drifts, unique sponge bio herms, artificial reefs, and stunning ocean and mountain scenery - explore it all on our 5-Hour boat dive trip! Just minutes from Vancouver and take our customized boat "Topline" to explore the emerald waters of Howe Sound. Here you can commonly see Pacific octopus, wolf eels, nudibranchs, and beautifully bizarre fish such as the decorated warbonnet and grunt sculpin. British Columbia was voted the #1 diving destination in North America because of its biodiversity and vibrant life. Its nutrient rich waters and amazing topography make for stunning diving. services.name: kayak vancouver
services.desc: Grab a kayak and hop on our custom 40ft vessel that will take you and your kayak to a nearby island to explore. Howe Sound is one of the southernmost fjords in North America, and this stunning scenery is right in our backyard! There is a good chance you will see harbour seals, eagles, sea stars, anemones, jellyfish, and much more! Our vessel is comfortable for all weather, and is equipped with all safety equipment, a marine toilet, an upper open viewing deck, and a covered lower deck in case of rain. services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Tip a glass of bubbly with us, as the sun drops into the Salish Sea! You may encounter bald eagles and other sea birds, harbour seals, and occasionally even dolphins or whales. Meet at our Expedition Centre in Horseshoe Bay - the gateway to Howe Sound - located just 25 minutes from downtown Vancouver. Hop on our custom 40ft boat and we will take you on a 2-hour sunset cruise while you enjoy the magnificent scenery in Howe Sound - the southernmost fjord in North America - from our comfortable vessel. services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: ​Sea Dragon provides private boat tours and specialized charters for groups of all sizes. Our boat Topline can accommodate up to 12 guests at a time depending on the desired charter activity. We offer a variety of schedules to meet your group’s needs. You may choose your boating activity from one of our standardized tours - scuba, snorkel, kayak, stand-up paddle board, or just cruise on the vessel and watch the fun and the wildlife! Want to plan an activity outside of our tour offering? Shoot us an email with what you're thinking and we can try to arrange it!
